en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hafs Bin Bakhtary, and someone else, 
from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is disliked for the man that he should descend into the grave of his son’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Um ay r from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtariy and others who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
it is undesirable for a man to enter the grave of his sons.”
